q.id: Sebelum menjalankan page.click() / locator.click(), apa yang dilakukan Playwright secara otomatis?
q.en: Before running page.click() / locator.click(), what does Playwright do automatically?

id: Menunggu elemen visible, stabil, enabled, dan bisa menerima event (actionability checks)
Langsung klik tanpa menunggu apa pun
en: Waits for the element to be visible, stable, enabled and able to receive events (actionability checks)
Clicks immediately without waiting
Always waits a fixed 30 seconds
Waits for networkidle then clicks

exp.id: Auto-waiting memeriksa kesiapan elemen sampai timeout, sehingga sleep tetap hampir tidak diperlukan. Menunggu fixed 30 detik atau networkidle bukan perilaku default.
exp.en: Auto-waiting checks the element is ready until timeout, so fixed sleeps are rarely needed. A fixed 30-second wait or networkidle is not the default behaviour.

q.id: Locator mana yang paling disarankan karena paling tahan terhadap perubahan tampilan?
q.en: Which locator is most recommended because it best survives UI changes?

en: page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Pay' })
page.locator('div:nth-child(3) > div > button')
page.locator('//*[@id="root"]/div[2]/button')
page.locator('.btn.btn-primary.mt-4')

exp.id: Locator berbasis role, label, atau test id mencerminkan cara pengguna melihat halaman dan jarang patah. Selector posisi dan kelas gaya rapuh terhadap perubahan struktur.
exp.en: Role, label or test-id locators mirror how users see the page and rarely break. Position and styling-class selectors are brittle against structure changes.

q.id: Mengapa await expect(locator).toBeVisible() lebih baik daripada expect(await locator.isVisible()).toBe(true)?
q.en: Why is await expect(locator).toBeVisible() better than expect(await locator.isVisible()).toBe(true)?

id: Web-first assertion mencoba ulang sampai timeout, sedangkan isVisible() hanya membaca sekali sehingga rawan flaky
toBeVisible() lebih cepat karena tidak menunggu
isVisible() tidak bisa dipakai di TypeScript
en: The web-first assertion retries until timeout, while isVisible() reads once and is prone to flakiness
They are identical
toBeVisible() is faster because it does not wait
isVisible() cannot be used in TypeScript

exp.id: Assertion async Playwright melakukan retry hingga kondisi terpenuhi atau timeout. Pembacaan sekali (snapshot) tidak menunggu UI selesai berubah.
exp.en: Playwright's async assertions retry until the condition holds or times out. A one-shot read (snapshot) doesn't wait for the UI to settle.

q.id: Apa manfaat BrowserContext baru untuk setiap test di Playwright?
q.en: What is the benefit of a fresh BrowserContext per test in Playwright?

id: Cookie, storage, dan sesi terisolasi antar test tanpa perlu membuka browser baru
Semua test berbagi login yang sama secara otomatis
en: Cookies, storage and sessions are isolated between tests without launching a new browser
All tests automatically share the same login
Tests automatically run sequentially
No browser needs to be installed

exp.id: Context itu murah dan terisolasi, sehingga test independen dan bisa paralel. Berbagi sesi harus dilakukan eksplisit, mis. lewat storageState.
exp.en: Contexts are cheap and isolated, keeping tests independent and parallel-friendly. Sharing a session must be explicit, e.g. via storageState.

q.id: Aplikasi butuh login, dan login lewat UI di setiap test memperlambat suite. Pendekatan yang tepat di Playwright?
q.en: The app requires login and logging in via the UI in every test slows the suite. What is the right Playwright approach?

id: Login sekali di setup project, simpan storageState, lalu pakai ulang di test
Hapus login dari aplikasi saat test
Login manual sebelum menjalankan suite lalu jangan ditutup
en: Log in once in a setup project, save storageState, then reuse it in tests
Remove login from the app during tests
Log in manually before the run and never close the browser
Use a longer waitForTimeout

exp.id: storageState menyimpan cookie dan localStorage hasil login, sehingga test tetap terisolasi tetapi tidak mengulang login. Trade-off: kalau yang diuji adalah alur login itu sendiri, tetap uji lewat UI.
exp.en: storageState saves the cookies and localStorage from login, keeping tests isolated without repeating login. Trade-off: if the login flow itself is under test, still go through the UI.

q.id: Anda ingin menguji tampilan saat API produk mengembalikan HTTP 500 tanpa merusak backend. Cara di Playwright?
q.en: You want to test the UI when the products API returns HTTP 500 without breaking the backend. How in Playwright?

id: Ubah kode aplikasi agar melempar error
en: page.route('**/api/products', route => route.fulfill({ status: 500 }))
Shut the backend server down manually
Change app code to throw an error
It cannot be tested in Playwright

exp.id: page.route mencegat request dan menjawab dengan respons buatan, sehingga kondisi error dapat diuji deterministik. Pastikan juga ada test happy path terhadap backend asli.
exp.en: page.route intercepts the request and answers with a fabricated response so error states are tested deterministically. Keep a happy-path test against the real backend too.

q.id: Mengapa const el = cy.get('#total'); el.text() tidak bekerja di Cypress?
q.en: Why does const el = cy.get('#total'); el.text() not work in Cypress?

id: Command Cypress dijalankan async dalam antrean dan mengembalikan chainable, bukan nilai; gunakan .then() atau alias
Karena cy.get hanya mendukung ID kelas
Karena Cypress tidak punya fungsi text()
en: Cypress commands are queued and asynchronous and return a chainable, not a value; use .then() or an alias
Because cy.get only supports class IDs
Because Cypress has no text() function
Because you must use await

exp.id: Cypress tidak memakai async/await; command dirangkai dan dieksekusi berurutan. Mengambil nilai harus lewat .then(), .invoke(), atau alias.
exp.en: Cypress does not use async/await; commands are chained and run in order. Values must be read via .then(), .invoke() or aliases.

q.id: Bagaimana cara mengintersep dan menunggu request API tertentu di Cypress agar test tidak memakai cy.wait(ms)?
q.en: How do you intercept and wait for a specific API request in Cypress instead of using cy.wait(ms)?

en: cy.intercept('GET', '/api/orders').as('orders') then cy.wait('@orders')
cy.wait(5000) after every click
cy.request() replacing all UI tests
Calling cy.reload() repeatedly

exp.id: Alias intersepsi membuat test menunggu kejadian nyata (request selesai), bukan waktu tebakan, sehingga lebih stabil dan cepat.
exp.en: An intercept alias makes the test wait for a real event (request completed) instead of guessed time, so it is more stable and faster.

q.id: Apa yang dimaksud retry-ability pada Cypress?
q.en: What does retry-ability mean in Cypress?

id: Query dan assertion diulang otomatis sampai lolos atau timeout (default 4 detik)
Seluruh test diulang jika gagal tanpa konfigurasi
Command yang mengubah state (mis. click) diulang berkali-kali
en: Queries and assertions are retried automatically until they pass or time out (default 4 seconds)
The whole test is rerun on failure without configuration
State-changing commands (e.g. click) are retried repeatedly
Cypress reruns tests until green

exp.id: Yang diulang adalah query beserta assertion setelahnya, bukan aksi yang mengubah state. Retry seluruh test adalah fitur test retries yang harus dikonfigurasi dan sebaiknya tidak menutupi flakiness.
exp.en: What retries is the query plus its assertions, not state-changing actions. Retrying whole tests is the separate test-retries feature, which must be configured and shouldn't mask flakiness.

q.id: Login lewat UI sebelum setiap test memperlambat suite Cypress. Solusi yang disarankan?
q.en: Logging in via the UI before every Cypress test slows the suite. What is the recommended solution?

id: cy.session() untuk menyimpan dan memulihkan sesi login (login lewat API bila memungkinkan)
en: cy.session() to cache and restore the login session (log in via API where possible)
Log in manually and then run Cypress
Disable authentication in the app
Use cy.wait(10000) when logging in

exp.id: cy.session menyimpan cookie, localStorage, dan sessionStorage antar test. Login lewat UI cukup diuji sekali di test khusus.
exp.en: cy.session caches cookies, localStorage and sessionStorage between tests. UI login only needs one dedicated test.

q.id: Alur test berpindah dari app.contoh.com ke domain berbeda (SSO pihak ketiga). Apa yang perlu diperhatikan di Cypress?
q.en: A test flow moves from app.example.com to a different domain (third-party SSO). What should you consider in Cypress?

id: Gunakan cy.origin() untuk perintah di domain lain; Cypress tidak mendukung banyak tab
Cypress tidak bisa menguji aplikasi yang memakai SSO
Cukup ganti baseUrl di tengah test
en: Use cy.origin() for commands on another domain; Cypress does not support multiple tabs
There is no limitation
Cypress cannot test apps that use SSO
Just change baseUrl mid-test

exp.id: Cypress berjalan di dalam browser dengan batasan same-origin; cy.origin() mengizinkan perintah di origin kedua. Alternatif: login SSO lewat API/cy.session.
exp.en: Cypress runs inside the browser with same-origin constraints; cy.origin() allows commands on a second origin. Alternative: log in to SSO via API/cy.session.

q.id: Di Katalon Studio, cara terbaik menjalankan test suite yang sama di environment staging dan production dengan URL berbeda?
q.en: In Katalon Studio, the best way to run the same test suite against staging and production with different URLs?

id: Execution Profile berisi variabel global (mis. baseUrl) yang dipilih saat eksekusi
Menyalin test case dan mengganti URL manual
Menulis URL langsung di tiap langkah
en: An Execution Profile with global variables (e.g. baseUrl) selected at run time
Copying test cases and changing URLs manually
Hard-coding the URL in every step
Two separate projects

exp.id: Profile memisahkan konfigurasi per environment dari logika test, sehingga satu test case dipakai ulang.
exp.en: Profiles separate per-environment configuration from test logic so one test case is reused.

q.id: Apa fungsi Test Suite Collection di Katalon?
q.en: What is a Test Suite Collection in Katalon for?

id: Menjalankan beberapa test suite sekaligus, mis. di beberapa browser atau profile, secara berurutan atau paralel
en: Running several test suites together, e.g. across browsers or profiles, sequentially or in parallel
Storing element locators
Storing CSV test data
Creating bug reports automatically

exp.id: Test Case = satu skenario, Test Suite = kumpulan test case, Test Suite Collection = kumpulan test suite untuk eksekusi lintas browser/environment.
exp.en: Test Case = one scenario, Test Suite = a set of test cases, Test Suite Collection = a set of suites for cross-browser/environment execution.

q.id: Langkah login dipakai di puluhan test case Katalon. Cara menghindari duplikasi?
q.en: A login step is used in dozens of Katalon test cases. How to avoid duplication?

id: Membuat custom keyword (Groovy) atau test case yang dipanggil ulang
Menyalin langkah login ke setiap test case
en: Create a custom keyword (Groovy) or a reusable test case that is called
Copy the login steps into every test case
Re-record each time
Remove login from the tests

exp.id: Custom keyword menyatukan logika yang sama di satu tempat, sehingga perubahan UI login hanya diperbaiki sekali.
exp.en: A custom keyword keeps shared logic in one place, so a login UI change is fixed once.

q.id: Mengapa Test Objects di Object Repository Katalon penting untuk maintainability?
q.en: Why do Test Objects in Katalon's Object Repository matter for maintainability?

id: Locator disimpan terpusat sehingga satu perubahan memperbaiki semua test yang memakainya; self-healing dapat memakai locator alternatif
Karena membuat test berjalan lebih cepat
en: Locators are kept centrally so one change fixes every test using them; self-healing can use alternative locators
Because it makes tests run faster
Because it removes the need for assertions
Because it writes test data automatically

exp.id: Pemusatan locator adalah ide yang sama dengan Page Object Model: perubahan UI cukup diperbaiki di satu tempat.
exp.en: Centralising locators is the same idea as the Page Object Model: a UI change is fixed in one place.

q.id: Query mana yang menemukan email yang terdaftar lebih dari sekali di tabel users?
q.en: Which query finds emails registered more than once in the users table?

id: SELECT email, COUNT(*) FROM users GROUP BY email HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
SELECT email FROM users WHERE COUNT(*) > 1
SELECT email FROM users ORDER BY email
en: SELECT email, COUNT(*) FROM users GROUP BY email HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
SELECT email FROM users WHERE COUNT(*) > 1
SELECT DISTINCT email FROM users
SELECT email FROM users ORDER BY email

exp.id: Agregat difilter dengan HAVING setelah GROUP BY. WHERE tidak boleh memakai fungsi agregat.
exp.en: Aggregates are filtered with HAVING after GROUP BY. WHERE cannot use aggregate functions.

q.id: Query mana yang menemukan pelanggan yang belum pernah membuat pesanan?
q.en: Which query finds customers who have never placed an order?

id: SELECT c.* FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.id IS NULL
SELECT c.* FROM customers c INNER JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
SELECT c.* FROM customers c WHERE c.id = NULL
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer_id IS NULL
en: SELECT c.* FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.id IS NULL
SELECT c.* FROM customers c INNER JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
SELECT c.* FROM customers c WHERE c.id = NULL
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer_id IS NULL

exp.id: LEFT JOIN mempertahankan semua pelanggan; yang tidak punya pesanan memiliki kolom o.id NULL. NOT EXISTS juga valid. '= NULL' tidak pernah benar.
exp.en: LEFT JOIN keeps all customers; those without orders have o.id NULL. NOT EXISTS is also valid. '= NULL' is never true.

q.id: Apa beda WHERE dan HAVING?
q.en: What is the difference between WHERE and HAVING?

id: WHERE memfilter baris sebelum pengelompokan; HAVING memfilter grup hasil agregasi
WHERE hanya untuk angka; HAVING hanya untuk teks
en: WHERE filters rows before grouping; HAVING filters groups after aggregation
They are exactly the same
WHERE is for numbers only; HAVING is for text only
HAVING runs before WHERE

exp.id: Urutan logis: FROM, WHERE, GROUP BY, HAVING, SELECT, ORDER BY.
exp.en: Logical order: FROM, WHERE, GROUP BY, HAVING, SELECT, ORDER BY.

q.id: Anda perlu pesanan terbaru untuk setiap user. Pendekatan window function yang tepat?
q.en: You need each user's most recent order. Which window-function approach is right?

id: Beri ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY created_at DESC), lalu ambil yang bernomor 1
ORDER BY created_at lalu LIMIT 1 untuk semua user
GROUP BY user_id tanpa fungsi agregat
en: Use ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY created_at DESC), then keep row number 1
SELECT MAX(*) FROM orders
ORDER BY created_at then LIMIT 1 for all users
GROUP BY user_id without aggregate functions

exp.id: PARTITION BY membuat penomoran per user. LIMIT 1 hanya mengembalikan satu baris untuk seluruh tabel.
exp.en: PARTITION BY numbers rows per user. LIMIT 1 returns a single row for the whole table.

q.id: Tabel orders memiliki 3 pesanan: A (2 item), B (1 item), C (0 item). Berapa baris hasil orders LEFT JOIN order_items ON order_items.order_id = orders.id?
q.en: The orders table has 3 orders: A (2 items), B (1 item), C (0 items). How many rows does orders LEFT JOIN order_items ON order_items.order_id = orders.id return?

exp.id: A menghasilkan 2 baris, B 1 baris, dan C 1 baris dengan kolom item NULL. Total 4. INNER JOIN hanya 3. Berhati-hatilah menghitung baris setelah join satu-ke-banyak.
exp.en: A yields 2 rows, B 1 row, and C 1 row with NULL item columns. Total 4. INNER JOIN would give 3. Be careful counting rows after a one-to-many join.

q.id: Anda ingin semua pesanan yang statusnya bukan 'paid', termasuk yang status-nya NULL. Mengapa WHERE status <> 'paid' bermasalah?
q.en: You want all orders whose status is not 'paid', including NULL status. Why is WHERE status <> 'paid' a problem?

id: Perbandingan dengan NULL menghasilkan UNKNOWN, sehingga baris NULL terlewat; tambahkan OR status IS NULL
en: Comparison with NULL yields UNKNOWN, so NULL rows are missed; add OR status IS NULL
The <> operator does not exist in SQL
Because case is always ignored
There is no problem

exp.id: Logika tiga nilai SQL: NULL <> 'paid' bukan TRUE. Ini sumber bug validasi data yang umum.
exp.en: SQL's three-valued logic: NULL <> 'paid' is not TRUE. A common source of data-validation bugs.

q.id: Bagaimana Anda memutuskan test mana yang layak diotomasi?
q.en: How do you decide which tests are worth automating?

model.id: Otomasi test yang stabil, berulang, dan berisiko tinggi (regression, smoke, jalur kritis bisnis, data-driven); biarkan manual yang berubah cepat, sekali pakai, atau butuh penilaian manusia seperti eksploratori dan UX. Pertimbangkan biaya maintenance dan return on investment.
model.en: Automate tests that are stable, repeated and high-risk (regression, smoke, business-critical paths, data-driven); keep manual those that change often, are one-off or need human judgement such as exploratory and UX. Weigh maintenance cost and return on investment.

q.id: Test otomasi Anda flaky (kadang lolos, kadang gagal). Bagaimana Anda menanganinya?
q.en: Your automated test is flaky (sometimes passes, sometimes fails). How do you handle it?

model.id: Reproduksi dan cari akar masalah: timing/waiting, data uji yang saling mengganggu, lingkungan tidak stabil, atau locator rapuh. Perbaiki dengan wait berbasis kondisi, isolasi data, mock dependensi tak stabil; karantina sementara agar tidak menghalangi pipeline, dan jangan sekadar menambah retry.
model.en: Reproduce and find the root cause: timing/waiting, test data interference, unstable environment or brittle locators. Fix with condition-based waits, data isolation, mocking unstable dependencies; quarantine temporarily so the pipeline is not blocked, and don't just add retries.

q.id: Anda diminta menguji fitur tanpa requirement yang jelas. Apa langkah Anda?
q.en: You are asked to test a feature without clear requirements. What do you do?

model.id: Cari informasi dulu: tanya product owner dan developer, baca desain atau fitur serupa, tulis asumsi dan konfirmasi. Gunakan exploratory testing dan teknik berbasis pengalaman, dokumentasikan temuan, lalu ubah menjadi acceptance criteria yang disepakati.
model.en: Gather information first: ask the product owner and developers, read designs or similar features, write down and confirm assumptions. Use exploratory and experience-based testing, document findings, then turn them into agreed acceptance criteria.

q.id: Bagaimana Anda melaporkan risiko rilis kepada stakeholder non-teknis?
q.en: How do you report release risk to non-technical stakeholders?

model.id: Gunakan bahasa dampak bisnis, bukan istilah teknis: apa yang sudah diuji, apa yang belum, defect terbuka beserta tingkat keparahan dan dampak pengguna, serta rekomendasi (rilis, rilis dengan mitigasi, tunda). Sajikan ringkas dengan data seperti status pass/fail dan cakupan area berisiko.
model.en: Use business-impact language, not technical jargon: what was tested, what was not, open defects with severity and user impact, and a recommendation (release, release with mitigation, delay). Keep it concise with data such as pass/fail status and coverage of risky areas.

q.id: Ceritakan bug sulit yang pernah Anda temukan dengan format STAR (tanpa data rahasia perusahaan).
q.en: Describe a hard bug you found using the STAR format (without confidential company data).

model.id: Situasi: konteks umum fitur dan masalahnya. Tugas: peran saya. Aksi: bagaimana saya mereproduksi, mempersempit penyebab, berkolaborasi dengan developer, dan menambah pengamanan. Hasil: bug diperbaiki dan dampak terukur, mis. regresi yang dicegah atau pelajaran proses.
model.en: Situation: general context of the feature and the problem. Task: my role. Action: how I reproduced, narrowed down the cause, collaborated with developers and added safeguards. Result: the bug fixed and a measurable effect, e.g. regression prevented or process learning.
